headline: 油價破百 股市走跌
context: 油價站上每桶100美元的同時，全球股市同步走跌。市場擔憂，若胡塞（Houthi）武裝真的封鎖曼德海峽（Bab al-Mandab），恐怕會扼住沙烏地阿拉伯的原油出口，戰事已從波斯灣一路延燒到紅海。

sources.name: Reuters
sources.summary: Oil settles over $100 as Houthi attacks intensify Middle East supply risks Reuters

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Sharp rise in oil price reflects fears Houthi militias could strangle Saudi exports as US-Iran fighting intensifies How the Bab al-Mandab blockade threat pushed oil back above $100 The oil price broke above $100 a barrel for the first time in two months as a fresh escalation of the Middle East conflict threatens to compound disruption to global oil supplies. The benchmark oil price rose sharply on Thursday, from $95 the day before, amid fears that Yemen’s Houthi militia could strangle Saudi oil exports through the Red Sea while US-Iran tensions over oil flows through the strait of Hormuz intensify. 油價破百 股市走跌

油價站上每桶100美元的同時，全球股市同步走跌。市場擔憂，若胡塞（Houthi）武裝真的封鎖曼德海峽（Bab al-Mandab），恐怕扼住沙烏地阿拉伯的原油出口，戰事已從波斯灣一路延燒到紅海。

—— 本則來自 Reuters、The Guardian、The New York Times，2026 年 7 月 23 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
